title: Assay result
description: A single element result for a sample, traceable to its certificate, method, and laboratory. Part of the geoDB Open Exploration Protocol (chain-of-custody records lane).

sample_name.description: Sample identifier the result belongs to.

unit.description: Unit of value (e.g. ppm, ppb, pct, g/t).

detection_limit.description: Lower detection limit for the method/element.

is_below_detection.description: True when the value is below detection.
